newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ming Wah buys tankers for US$86 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ming Wah buys tankers for US$86 mln.

text.p: Ship-owning and chartering company Ming Wah Universal (Bermuda) Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was buying two new crude oil tankers worth US$86 million as part of its fleet expansion.
Namura Shipbuilding Co Ltd will build the 105,500 deadweight tonne Aframax tankers, said Ming Wah, a unit of Hong Kong-listed China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd.
It said in a statement the price included additional upgrade items in order to meet higher operational standards.
The first vessel was expected to be delivered by July 1998 and the second by August 1998.

Chairman Wu Shi Rong said in the statement the company had not secured business employment for the two tankers but it was confident that profitable charter would be available as demand for this type of vessel would steadily increase.
Wu added the purchases would be financed through internal resources and external loan facilities.
